subject.title: Fix Claude never-prompt no-UI Keychain repair for missing credentials file (#1975)

question: Should Claude never-prompt mode permit Security.framework reads that are guaranteed to fail rather than show authentication UI, while the separate global switch continues to disable all Keychain access?
rationale: This changes a shipped credential-access boundary: the UI wording and separate kill switch support the proposed semantics, but explicit repository-owner approval is appropriate before silent Keychain reads become available to existing never-mode users.

options.title: Approve no-prompt semantics
options.body: Treat `.never` as prohibiting interactive UI but allow `KeychainNoUIQuery` reads, with the global switch reserved for disabling all Keychain access.

options.title: Preserve no-access semantics
options.body: Keep `.never` blocking every Claude Code Keychain read and require users to restore the credentials file or change settings.

recommendation.title: Approve no-prompt semantics
recommendation.body: Treat `.never` as prohibiting interactive UI but allow `KeychainNoUIQuery` reads, with the global switch reserved for disabling all Keychain access.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the repository and recently changed both Claude OAuth routing and Keychain prompt guidance in this area.
